name: get_service_details
description: Returns a service that belongs to the organization. Supports both ClickHouse services and Managed Postgres services; the service type is detected automatically from the service id and is reported in the `serviceType` field of the response.

organizationId.description: Organization that owns the service. Use the id of an organization returned by get_organizations.

serviceId.description: Service to retrieve: the id of a clickhouse-type or postgres-type service returned by get_services_list. The tool queries both service kinds and reports which one matched in serviceType.
